title: How does a book-style foldable hinge work?

sections.title: The short version

bullets.text: Two halves rotate around a shared axis, like the pages of a book.
A flexible display spans both halves and bends around a small radius at the fold.
OLED panels can bend because they need no rigid backlight.

How many folds can a hinge survive?

sections.title: What it means for app design

bullets.text: Unfolded, there is room for two panes: an answer beside its source.
Half-open, the bottom half can hold controls while the top half shows content.
